The metal Luminous Fidget Spinner Balls are blue and silver and have a green dot in the center. They were sold with a mini flashlight designed to create a glowing effect while the ball is spinning. The mini flashlights have two removable button cell batteries.

cpsc-26522.title: Walmart Recalls Mainstays 9-Drawer Fabric Dressers Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Tip-Over and Entrapment Hazards; Violates Mandatory Standard for Clothing Storage Units
cpsc-26522.reason: The recalled dressers are unstable if they are not anchored to the wall, posing tip-over and entrapment hazards that can result in risk of serious injuries or death to children. The dressers violate the mandatory safety standard as required by the STURDY Act.
cpsc-26522.company: Hop Thang Interior Wood Co. Ltd., of Vietnam
cpsc-26522.distribution: Sold in the United States at Walmart stores nationwide and online at Walmart.com from September 2023 through March 2026 for about $80.
cpsc-26522.remedy: Consumers should stop using the recalled dressers if they are not anchored to the wall immediately, place them in an area that children cannot access and contact Walmart for a full refund. Consumers will be asked to return the dressers' drawers to any Walmart store and dispose of the dressers' frame according to local and state regulations. Refund
retailers: Walmart stores nationwide and online at Walmart.com from September 2023 through March 2026 for about $80.
